label: Script-06
title: KOLEKSI LENGKAP 30 SET PROMPT BERSIRI 3 SCENE BATCH 4 (TOPIK 91 - 120)

guide.p:
Dokumen ini menyediakan 30 set prompt bersiri 3 scene berangkai (total 90 babak video 10 saat) yang diadaptasi sepenuhnya daripada Kompilasi 30 Skrip Listicle 60 Saat Gaya Mentor (Batch 4: Topik 91 - 120). Setiap set mengekalkan disiplin naratif yang terbukti berkesan:
• Scene 1 (Animasi 3D Kucing - Isu & Konflik): Memaparkan realiti cabaran kewangan, tekanan kenaikan kos hidup, godaan skim ansuran BNPL, kebocoran wang tunai, atau dilema kewangan harian secara santai.
• Scene 2 (Animasi 3D Kucing - Kesedaran & Tindakan Berhemat): Keluarga kucing mencapai titik perubahan dengan menyusun bajet, mengetepikan simpanan awal, dan memulakan tabiat berdisiplin.
• Scene 3 (Live-Action Wanita Berhijab - Solusi Emas Public Gold): Hos wanita Malaysia berhijab kemas menyambung iktibar daripada kisah kucing terus kepada penonton, merumuskan solusi simpanan emas fizikal Public Gold (GAP, Dinar, atau Gold Bar) dengan poster storyboard 8 panel dan video prompt 10 saat.
• Strict Zero Gold Rule: Visual dan sebutan 'emas', 'gold', 'dinar', atau 'jongkong' dilarang sama sekali dalam Scene 1 dan 2. Emas hanya muncul dalam Scene 3.
• Syarat Aurat Sempurna (Scene 3): Baju berlengan panjang penuh hingga pergelangan tangan dengan handsocks dalaman berona senada kelihatan sebagai kaf sempit. Forearm tidak terdedah sama sekali.
• Larangan Tabung Babi: Sebarang elemen tabung babi dilarang sama sekali di seluruh babak.
• Giliran 6 Gaya Bukaan Scene 3: Situasi Harian, Pengakuan Silap, Jawab Bantahan, Soalan + Reveal, Milestone, dan Sasaran Persona digilirkan secara seimbang tanpa mengulang gaya yang sama 3 kali berturut-turut.
Gunakan blok deskripsi watak ini sebagai input rujukan utama (Ingredient) dalam Google Flow untuk mengekalkan konsistensi visual keluarga kucing merentas semua babak:
Character reference sheet of a Malaysian domestic cat family, 3D animated feature film style.

items: Mother (Ibu): Adult calico cat, vibrant tri-color fur of warm ginger-orange, deep black patches, and clean white chest and paws; expressive emerald-green almond eyes, plush bushy tail, gentle and maternal facial expression.
Kitten 1 (Oren): Energetic bright ginger-orange tabby kitten, large round sapphire-blue eyes, white muzzle, playful and curious posture.
Kitten 2 (Kelabu): Thoughtful silver-grey tabby kitten with dark charcoal stripes, slightly oversized ears, observant honey-amber eyes.
Kitten 3 (Coklat): Smallest runt kitten, soft chocolate-brown marbled coat, big innocent hazel eyes, shy and clingy.
Kitten 4 (Putih): Pure pristine snow-white kitten, bright round lemon-yellow eyes, pink nose pads, dainty and lively.

guide.p: Setting: Cozy Malaysian single-story terrace living room with polished teak wood flooring, wooden slatted louvre blinds, warm late-afternoon sunlight filtering in, lush green potted tropical plants in the corner.
Style: Premium 3D animation, soft tactile fur grooming detail, subsurface scattering on ears, shallow depth of field, warm cinematic color grading.
Vertical 9:16 composition. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no subtitles anywhere in the image.

scenes.imagePrompt:
Create a premium storyboard infographic poster using ChatGPT Image 2.
Canvas
- Aspect ratio: 1:1.414 (A-series portrait)
- White background with thin black borders.
- Bold, modern typography.
- Premium cinematic 3D illustrations.
- Professional commercial storyboard layout with clear visual storytelling.

Header: Nilai Emas Mustahil Menjadi Sifar — Storyboard Infographic
Legend
Include a small legend with icons for:
- Action
- Reaction
- Time
- Key Object
Main Character / Subject
Malaysian woman in her late 20s to early 30s with an approachable, professional, and trustworthy presence. She wears an elegant, modest long-sleeved outfit and a stylishly wrapped hijab with clean neat folds. Her outer top always has full-length long sleeves reaching all the way down to the wrists - never three-quarter, never rolled up, never pushed back. Underneath the sleeves she wears plain close-fitting inner handsocks in a neutral color matching the outfit, visible only as a narrow cuff peeking out at the wrists and covering the wrists; her forearms are never exposed.
Storyboard
1. Opener - WIDE SHOT, 0:00-0:01.25
Action: Malaysian woman in tailored navy-blue modest blazer and soft ivory folded hijab stands in an executive finance gallery.
Emotion: Authoritative, calm
Time: 0:00-0:01.25
Key Object: Finance gallery showcase table
2. Setup - MEDIUM SHOT, 0:01.25-0:02.5
Action: Host gestures outward, discussing how paper currencies and corporate giants can collapse overnight.
Dialogue: "Tengok bila sistem wang goyah."
Emotion: Serious, engaging
Time: 0:01.25-0:02.5
Key Object: Tablet displaying economic history
3. First Action - CLOSE SHOT, 0:02.5-0:03.75
Action: Host shakes her head slightly, pointing to failed corporate bonds and worthless paper currencies in history.
Dialogue: "Syarikat gergasi dunia boleh muflis."
Emotion: Stern, realistic
Time: 0:02.5-0:03.75
Key Object: Host expressive hands with cuffs
4. Turning Point - DYNAMIC SHOT, 0:03.75-0:05.0
Action: Host raises a gleaming 10g Public Gold bar with LBMA accreditation, reflecting brilliant gallery light.
Details: Her long sleeves stay down to wrists with matching handsocks visible only at cuffs.
Emotion: Solid, reassuring
Time: 0:03.75-0:05.0
Key Object: 10g Public Gold gold bar
5. Progress - MEDIUM SHOT, 0:05-0:06.25
Action: Host explains that physical gold stands alone without counterparty risk, recognized as money for 5000 years.
Dialogue: "Emas fizikal mustahil bernilai sifar."
Emotion: Authoritative, confident
Time: 0:05-0:06.25
Key Object: 10g gold bar in blister pack
6. Unique Angle - TOP SHOT overhead, 0:06.25-0:07.5
Action: Overhead view showing the 10g gold bar resting beside an antique merchant scale on polished black granite.
Emotion: Prestigious, permanent
Time: 0:06.25-0:07.5
Key Object: Gold bar and merchant scale
7. Final Action - CLOSE SHOT, 0:07.5-0:08.75
Action: Host holds the gold bar securely at chest level, looking straight into the lens with deep conviction.
Emotion: Inspiring, sincere
Time: 0:07.5-0:08.75
Key Object: 10g Public Gold gold bar
8. Reveal - HERO SHOT, 0:08.75-0:10.0
Action: Host smiles radiantly, holding the gold bar forward as the ultimate shelter of family wealth.
Dialogue: "Simpan aset penyelamat zaman-berzaman!"
Emotion: Triumphant, empowering
Time: 0:08.75-0:10.0
Key Object: 10g Public Gold gold bar
Requirements
- Total runtime: 10 seconds across exactly 8 distinct panels.
- Sleeves stay full length down to the wrists in every panel, with plain inner handsocks showing only as a narrow cuff at the wrists. Never three-quarter sleeves, never rolled-up sleeves, never bare forearms.
- Do not include a piggy bank anywhere in the storyboard.
- Dialogue text shown in the poster should be in Bahasa Melayu exactly as given above - do not translate to English.
- Maintain consistent character facial features, hijab styling, and outfit across all panels.
Output
Output only the completed storyboard infographic poster in a 1:1.414 portrait aspect ratio.
